newsitem.title: USA: FCOJ weekly movement rises to 6.500 mln gallons.
newsitem.headline: FCOJ weekly movement rises to 6.500 mln gallons.

text.p: The Florida Citrus Processors Association said frozen concentrated orange juice movement into trade channels for the week ended January 25 was 6,500,506 gallons compared with 5,198,847 gallons last week.
Imports were 860,710 gallons compared with 2,840,699 gallons the previous week. There were no domestic receipts for this week or the previous week.
Retail movement was 1,513,404 gallons, while bulk movement was 4,540,876 gallons.
Current season cumulative movement was 40,403,837 gallons.
The final total pack for the season is 104,869,528 gallons. -- New York Commodities Desk, 212-859-1640
